flags.old: Then Jaeha's trouser leg rides up, and Nib's ears go flat. The Call left a mark.
flags.problem: The art shows Nib crouched and pointing one long finger at the ankle, his ears sticking out sideways as usual, so 'Nib's ears go flat' describes something that is not drawn.
flags.new: Then Jaeha's trouser leg rides up, and Nib points straight at the ankle. The Call left a mark.

flags.old: Meanwhile Nib runs a rim no wider than a foot, with nothing but sky beside him.
flags.problem: The art shows Nib running on the broad floor slab beside a raised outer ledge, with the drop beyond the ledge and sky only in the top corner, not along a foot-wide rim with nothing but sky beside him.
flags.new: Meanwhile Nib runs the crumbling edge of the floor, one slip from a seven-storey drop.

flags.old: Then Borro flares moss green, and he shoves. The whole pack flies back down the beam.
flags.problem: The art shows one hound still hanging from the shield's top rim by its jaws while the rest are flung away, so 'the whole pack flies back' is wrong, and the clinger the next line depends on is already on screen here.
flags.new: Then Borro flares moss green and shoves. The pack is hurled back, all but one, which hangs on by its teeth.

flags.old: But one hangs on and rakes his arm, and the gash opens on Jaeha's shoulder.
flags.problem: P46 shows only Jaeha and Yerin, so 'one hangs on and rakes his arm' narrates the clinging hound drawn in P45 and a claw that is off-panel, and over a close-up of Jaeha it sounds as if his own arm was raked.
flags.new: Out on the beam, its claws rake Borro's arm, and the gash opens on Jaeha's shoulder.

flags.old: Then, quiet. The glow fades, and both summons look back at Jaeha.
flags.problem: Nib, by the far column, faces back toward the core wall, but Borro's masked head is drawn in profile looking across the floor, so 'both summons look back at Jaeha' is only half true.
flags.new: Then, quiet. The glow fades. Borro stands alone on the beam, and Nib looks back at Jaeha.

art_vs_script.note: Nib's ears stick out sideways as usual; the acting note asks for ears flat.
Nine hounds are drawn in front of the alpha; the pack is eight (P31 and P33 both draw eight).
The plan shows seven hounds plus the alpha, not eight.
Borro is drawn in rest form, with no moss-green glow or outline, though he is in field form from P37. His outline first appears in P45 and his green eyes in P51.
Borro has no field-form glow or outline (as in P38).
Nib runs on the broad floor slab beside a raised outer ledge, not on a rim of slab no wider than a foot.
Borro has no field-form glow or outline (as in P38).
Jaeha's outflung hands are plain gloves, not lit one amber and one moss green.
Yerin's hands on his shoulder are not glowing mint, though the script puts her glowing hand in the foreground.
Borro's masked head is in profile facing the far column, not looking back at Jaeha as the acting note says.
